title: Shapes Take Turns
subtitle: A ten-second golden example: code-drawn shapes, synthesized sound, no media files and no paid calls.

notes.title: What it tests
notes.text: Board camera pan with motion blur, a zoom-out finale, type-on, draw-on, count-up, pops, idle motion, and a custom shot that uses the acting kit.

notes.title: How it was made
notes.text: Drawn and animated in plain JavaScript on a canvas; every sound is synthesized in the browser. The two narration lines have timings but no audio, so they appear as captions only.

credits: Sound: synthesized with the Web Audio API
No generated images, voices or music in this example
